recommended fix: Configure repository secrets and verify the artifact

title: First launch ignored device locale

reproduction steps: Launch fresh install with French or Arabic device locale
recommended fix: Deploy migration and complete device-level verification

title: Static analysis baseline is non-clean
recommended fix: Remove warnings and deprecations or establish a reviewed warning baseline

title: Tests emitted unmocked SharedPreferences MissingPluginException
evidence: Fixed: test now installs SharedPreferences mock values; 13 targeted tests pass
recommended fix: Run full suite in CI and retain any remaining failures

title: Broad media permissions declared
evidence: Fixed: READ_MEDIA_IMAGES and READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE removed; manifest policy test passes
reproduction steps: Exercise gallery and file picker on Android 12 and 13+
recommended fix: Keep system picker flow; restore no broad permission

title: Account deletion was not failure-atomic
evidence: Fixed in source: durable RLS-protected job records request/storage/auth/failure states and retry is idempotent; static guardrail test passes
reproduction steps: Force auth deletion to fail after a successful Storage removal
recommended fix: Deploy migration/function and test job lifecycle against isolated Supabase

title: iOS bundle name used legacy SafeSpend
evidence: Fixed: CFBundleName and CFBundleDisplayName both VVollet; static plist test passes
reproduction steps: Install and inspect iOS system surfaces
recommended fix: Verify in an iOS release build

title: Android build tools nearing Flutter support cutoff
evidence: flutter build appbundle reports Gradle 8.14 AGP 8.11.1 and Kotlin 2.2.20 will soon lose support
reproduction steps: Run signed release build after upgrades
recommended fix: Upgrade Gradle AGP and Kotlin together in a dedicated tested change

title: Production deletion and retention claims are not independently verified
evidence: The public page is reachable but states 30-day support deletion and 30-day backup overwrite periods; no website source, Supabase project access, backup configuration, or disposable account was available to verify those facts.
reproduction steps: Request deletion by email and inspect backup/hosting retention controls
recommended fix: Verify or correct the published policy and run the documented isolated-Supabase test before Play submission
